architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events via SVC-102 (Event Bus). Within CAP-002, SVC-007 (Treasury Services) may call SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core) directly via synchronous same-capability API. SVC-007 and SVC-005 are promoted sub-capability peers within CAP-002. Cross-capability boundaries: CAP-002 → CAP-005 (sanctions) and CAP-002 ↔ CAP-003 (settlement) are events only.

services.role_in_journey: Primary owner of JRN-014. Creates and manages FXTrade (ENT-040), FXQuote (ENT-041), FXSettlement (ENT-042). Orchestrates all five phases of the FX spot trade lifecycle. Enforces 30-second quote validity window. Gates settlement on sanctions clearance (EVT-089 / CAP-005). Triggers SWIFT confirmation and nostro settlement via CAP-003 cross-capability events. Manages MiFIR transaction reporting to FCA trade repository.

consumed_events.name: FXSettlementCompleted
consumed_events.purpose: PH-063: Received from CAP-003 (cross-capability) on completion of nostro settlement. SVC-007 updates FXSettlement.settlement_status = settled, populates settled_at and swift_settlement_ref from event payload, transitions FXTrade.status = settled, and records FX P&L mark. Idempotent on settlement_id.

consumed_apis.call_pattern: Synchronous (direct API — same-capability permitted, both within CAP-002)
endpoints: GET /business-customers/{id} — PH-059: validate BusinessCustomer.status = active before creating FXTrade
GET /business-accounts/{id} — PH-061: check sell-currency account balance before trade booking
POST /business-accounts/{id}/debit — PH-063: debit sell-currency account at settlement (must succeed before EVT-087 published)
POST /business-accounts/{id}/credit — PH-063: credit buy-currency account at settlement
consumed_apis.purpose: SVC-007 is the promoted sub-capability peer of SVC-005 within CAP-002. Same-capability direct API calls permitted per architectural principle. SVC-007 holds no local copy of BusinessCustomer or BusinessAccount entity data — all reads go to SVC-005 at runtime.

consumed_apis.call_pattern: Synchronous (streaming rate subscription; sub-250ms staleness threshold)
consumed_apis.purpose: Real-time interbank FX mid-rate for indicative and firm quote generation. PH-059 and PH-060. Fallback: manual price entry with dual-approval controls (EXC-003). Rate feed outage triggers 503 response to dealer.

Customer and dealer notifications at key lifecycle stages: trade enquiry acknowledgement (PH-059), quote provided with countdown (PH-060), trade executed confirmation (PH-061), trade confirmation (PH-062), settlement completed (PH-063).

consumed_apis.call_pattern: Synchronous batch submission (end-of-day T; retry with exponential backoff)
consumed_apis.purpose: MiFIR transaction reporting. SVC-007 generates the UTI, packages the trade report from FXTrade fields (trade_id, client LEI, currency pair, notional, rate, value_date, execution_venue, mifir_transaction_ref), and submits to the FCA-approved trade repository. Regulatory deadline: end of business day T.

design_decisions: SVC-007 does NOT call SVC-051 synchronously for sanctions screening. It publishes EVT-089 (cross-capability event) immediately after trade booking and gates settlement release on the absence of a hit notification within the SLA window. Settlement proceeds if no sanctions hit is received; settlement_status = sanctions_hold if a hit is returned.

SVC-007 does NOT call SVC-010 synchronously for SWIFT messaging. It publishes EVT-086 (FXTradeConfirmed) which SVC-010 consumes to transmit SWIFT MT300, and publishes EVT-087 (FXSettlementInitiated) which SVC-010 consumes to execute nostro settlement.

The account debit at PH-063 settlement is implemented as a synchronous POST /business-accounts/{id}/debit call from SVC-007 to SVC-005 (same-capability). This debit must succeed atomically before SVC-007 publishes EVT-087 (FXSettlementInitiated) to trigger CAP-003 settlement — ensuring no double-settlement risk.

services.role_in_journey: JRN-014 additions to existing SVC-005. Provides BusinessCustomer status validation and account balance checks (called synchronously by SVC-007, same-capability). Executes account debit (sell leg) and credit (buy leg) at settlement. Publishes no new events unique to JRN-014.

consumed_events.name: FXTradeExecuted
consumed_events.purpose: JRN-014 PH-061: SVC-005 updates BusinessCustomer's FX exposure summary (notional equivalent GBP) for internal credit risk monitoring. Does not gate any operation — informational update.

design_decisions: The account debit (sell leg) and credit (buy leg) at PH-063 are implemented as two sequential synchronous calls from SVC-007 to SVC-005: POST /business-accounts/{sell_account_id}/debit followed by POST /business-accounts/{buy_account_id}/credit. Both must succeed before SVC-007 publishes EVT-087. If the debit succeeds but the credit fails, SVC-007 holds EVT-087 and triggers a compensating credit via a retry pattern.

services.role_in_journey: Performs real-time counterparty sanctions screening in PH-061. Consumes EVT-089 (FXCounterpartySanctionsScreened, cross-capability from SVC-007) and screens the corporate client against OFSI, OFAC, UN, and HM Treasury sanctions lists. If hit detected, publishes a sanctions hit notification event consumed by SVC-007 to block FXSettlement.settlement_status = sanctions_hold. MLRO notified for EXC-001 resolution.

consumed_events.name: FXCounterpartySanctionsScreened
consumed_events.purpose: PH-061: Triggers pre-settlement counterparty sanctions screening. SVC-051 screens client_id and client_legal_name against live sanctions lists. Idempotent on screening_request_id.

design_decisions: SVC-051 is never called synchronously by SVC-007 across the CAP-002/CAP-005 boundary. All interaction is via EVT-089 (published by SVC-007) and a hit-notification event (published by SVC-051 on hit detection). This preserves the cross-capability async-only architectural constraint.

services.role_in_journey: Performs two cross-capability functions: (1) PH-062: Consumes EVT-086 (FXTradeConfirmed) to transmit SWIFT MT300 trade confirmation to the corporate client and counterparty bank. (2) PH-063: Consumes EVT-087 (FXSettlementInitiated) to execute nostro-to-nostro FX settlement on value_date using SWIFT MT300 settlement messages or pacs.009 (ISO 20022 CLS). Publishes EVT-088 (FXSettlementCompleted) on successful nostro confirmation.

consumed_events.name: FXTradeConfirmed
consumed_events.purpose: PH-062 [cross-capability from CAP-002]: Triggers SWIFT MT300 trade confirmation message dispatch to corporate client and counterparty correspondent bank BIC. Idempotent on trade_id.

consumed_events.name: FXSettlementInitiated
consumed_events.purpose: PH-063 [cross-capability from CAP-002]: Triggers nostro-to-nostro FX settlement on value_date. SVC-010 reads buy_leg_nostro and sell_leg_nostro BICs from payload, constructs SWIFT MT300 settlement or pacs.009 for CLS-eligible pairs, and instructs settlement. On SWIFT ACK and nostro confirmation: publishes EVT-088 (FXSettlementCompleted). Idempotent on settlement_id.

design_decisions: SVC-010 is the CAP-003 service responsible for all SWIFT messaging and nostro settlement execution. It owns the SWIFT connectivity layer (MT300 series and pacs.009). SVC-007 never calls SVC-010 directly — all coordination is event-driven via SVC-102.

services.role_in_journey: Routes all cross-capability events in JRN-014: EVT-089 (CAP-002 → CAP-005, topic: compliance.sanctions-screening), EVT-086 and EVT-087 (CAP-002 → CAP-003, topic: commercial.treasury), EVT-088 (CAP-003 → CAP-002, topic: commercial.treasury). Guarantees at-least-once delivery with idempotency enforced at consumers.

cross_service_interaction_summary.description: PER-003/PER-053 submits FX trade enquiry. SVC-007 calls SVC-005 synchronously (same-capability: GET /business-customers/{id}) to validate BusinessCustomer.status = active. SVC-007 fetches indicative rate from Bloomberg FXGO. Creates FXTrade (ENT-040, status=enquiry). Publishes EVT-083 (FXQuoteRequested).

SVC-007 generates firm quote from live Bloomberg FXGO rate + approved mark-up. Creates FXQuote (ENT-041, status=quoted, valid_until=now+30s). Publishes EVT-084 (FXQuoteProvided). 30-second countdown displayed on portal.

PER-003 accepts quote. SVC-007 calls SVC-005 (GET /business-accounts/{id}) to verify balance — same-capability. FXQuote.status = accepted. FXTrade.status = booked. EVT-085 (FXTradeExecuted) published. SVC-007 also publishes EVT-089 (FXCounterpartySanctionsScreened) [CROSS-CAPABILITY → CAP-005] to SVC-051 via SVC-102.

SVC-007 sets FXTrade.status = confirmed, confirmation_sent = true. Publishes EVT-086 (FXTradeConfirmed) [CROSS-CAPABILITY → CAP-003]. SVC-102 delivers EVT-086 to SVC-010, which transmits SWIFT MT300 confirmation. SVC-053 dispatches portal/email confirmation to PER-003.

On value_date T+2: SVC-007 calls SVC-005 (POST /business-accounts/{id}/debit and /credit) same-capability to debit sell leg and credit buy leg. Creates FXSettlement (ENT-042). Publishes EVT-087 (FXSettlementInitiated) [CROSS-CAPABILITY → CAP-003]. SVC-010 executes nostro settlement and publishes EVT-088 (FXSettlementCompleted) [CROSS-CAPABILITY → CAP-002]. SVC-007 consumes EVT-088 — updates FXSettlement.settlement_status = settled, FXTrade.status = settled.
